extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from the local XML/PDF/supplement surfaces; no antimicrobial mechanism is inferred.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: cFΦR4 is internalized through endocytosis and releases from early endosomes into the cytoplasm in mammalian cell experiments.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: cFΦR4/cFΦR4 cargo conjugates in HeLa and HEK293 cell assays
direct_assay_types: GR-GFP translocation assay with endocytosis inhibitors
mechanism_claims.limitations: Evidence is for cell-penetrating/endosomal escape behavior, not antimicrobial killing.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: cFΦR4 binds membrane phospholipids in small unilamellar vesicle assays and is more membrane-binding competent than R9/Tat under the tested conditions.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: FITC-labeled cFΦR4 compared with R9 and Tat in artificial membrane binding experiments
mechanism_claims.limitations: The membrane-binding assay supports CPP uptake/escape interpretation but is not an antimicrobial membrane-disruption assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The peptide enables cytosolic/nuclear delivery of peptide and protein cargos, including pCAP-containing reporters and GFP/PTP1B examples, with functional readouts in mammalian cells.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Cargo-delivery function is source-supported; no direct antimicrobial target or anticancer cytotoxic mechanism is assigned.
